component.name: M3UTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return
m.top.status = "Fetching playlist..."
http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(url) http.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.InitClientCertificates() http.AddHeader("User-Agent", "MasterChief-Roku/1.0") http.EnablePeerVerification(false) http.EnableHostVerification(false)
raw = http.GetToString() code = http.GetResponseCode()
if code < 200 or code >= 300 m.top.status = "error: HTTP " + str(code).trim() m.top.channels = [] return end if
m.top.status = "Parsing M3U..." channels = parseM3U(raw) m.top.channels = channels m.top.status = "ok:" + str(channels.count()).trim() end sub
' -- M3U parser -------------------------------------------------------------- ' Handles #EXTM3U, #EXTINF lines and stream URLs. ' Returns array of {name, url, group, logo, tvgId} function parseM3U(raw as String) as Object channels = [] current = invalid
lines = raw.Tokenize(chr(10))
for each rawLine in lines line = rawLine.trim() if line = "" ' skip blank else if Left(line, 7) = "#EXTINF" ' #EXTINF:-1 tvg-id="X" tvg-name="X" group-title="X" tvg-logo="X",Display Name current = {name: "", url: "", group: "Uncategorized", logo: "", tvgId: ""}
' extract display name (after last comma) commaPos = findLastComma(line) if commaPos > 0 current.name = Mid(line, commaPos + 2, Len(line)).trim() end if
' extract tvg-name (override display name if present) tvgName = extractAttr(line, "tvg-name") if tvgName <> "" then current.name = tvgName
current.tvgId = extractAttr(line, "tvg-id") current.group = extractAttr(line, "group-title") if current.group = "" then current.group = "Uncategorized" current.logo = extractAttr(line, "tvg-logo")
else if Left(line, 1) = "#" ' other directive - ignore else if current <> invalid ' this must be the stream URL current.url = line if current.name = "" then current.name = "Channel " + str(channels.count() + 1).trim() channels.push(current) current = invalid end if end for
return channels end function
' Find position of last comma in a string (1-based) function findLastComma(s as String) as Integer i = Len(s) while i > 0 if Mid(s, i, 1) = "," then return i i = i - 1 end while return -1 end function
' Extract a quoted attribute value: attr="value" or attr='value' function extractAttr(line as String, attrName as String) as String needle = attrName + "=" startIdx = Instr(1, line, needle) if startIdx = 0 then return ""
startIdx = startIdx + Len(needle) quote = Mid(line, startIdx, 1) if quote <> chr(34) and quote <> "'" then return ""
startIdx = startIdx + 1 endIdx = Instr(startIdx, line, quote) if endIdx = 0 then return ""
return Mid(line, startIdx, endIdx - startIdx) end function
